name: Black Creek State Forest Campground
evidence: old pin sat in the trailer park N of camp (OSM trailer_park); OSM camp_site + 3 loops at 43.7094-43.7123. Satellite 2025-10: canopy, but pad clearings at the treeline over an open grass bank ~30-40 m from ~50 m-wide Black Creek. DEM 206 m at pads vs 191 m water = ~15 m climb-down bank -> view, not on-water. DNR 'sites 3-6,9-11,14,15,17,20,21 accessible from the water'

name: Big Eric's Bridge State Forest Campground
evidence: satellite at 46.8650,-88.0842 + OSM camp_pitch 1-19: nearest pitches (1A, 2B, 15, 16) are 66-75 m from the Huron River centerline with a tree band between. Open meadow beside the rapids gives a view, no shoreline pads. DNR 'along the Huron River' is prose

name: Bray Creek State Forest Campground
evidence: satellite at 43.9147,-85.8244: continuous pine canopy. OSM loop 60-65 m from the Baldwin River (a small trout stream). DNR page: river access 'on the east side of the campground and down a set of stairs, adjacent to the day-use area' = climb-down

name: Black River State Forest Campground
evidence: pin (= DNR coord) sits in a cutover ~250 m NE; OSM camp_site loop at 46.1164-46.1173,-85.3645, matched by pad clearings in satellite frame at 46.1170,-85.3638. Loop 72-80 m from the Black River through forest; DNR says 'quick access', carry-in only

name: Bob Lake Campground
evidence: satellite at 46.6622,-88.9140: canopy + oblique low-sun frame, illegible. OSM loop 26-44 m from the Bob Lake edge, but no per-site map exists (FCFS, not on rec.gov). FS 'many of the sites are situated near the lake' is prose -> default down

name: Bowman Bridge Campground
evidence: rec.gov 233717 per-site coords (sites 001-016) span 43.8875-43.8885,-85.9407/-85.9437, no Proximity to Water tag; old pin was on the access road E of the loop. Satellite at 43.8878,-85.9400: nearest site ~90 m from the Pere Marquette through forest. FS: 'up the hill from' the boat landing

name: Brush Lake Campground
evidence: satellite at 43.6391,-85.6895: RVs on the E spur of the small loop; open unused grass ~25 m to a marsh fringe, open water ~45 m, carry-in launch path, no treeline. Frontage across the marsh fringe at the edge of the bound and low confidence -> coordinator held it at lakeview (default down). FS 'on the shores of Brush Lake'

name: Canoe Harbor State Forest Campground and Canoe Camp
evidence: satellite at 44.6073,-84.4704 + wide frame at 44.6040,-84.4680 + OSM camp_site: loops 300-530 m from the South Branch Au Sable through forest. DNR: the only river sites are 4 walk-in/canoe-access sites, which don't count
